name: Factor Neave
title: Factor, the Counting House
examine: Ink on the fingers, salt nowhere near the paper. Her columns balance to the grain and she resents that the town is proud of it.
lines: Mind the damp on your coin. It counts the same wet, but it counts slower.
I clerked under Cormund at the ford. He taught me the second count. The first one lies.
The vault is dry. That sentence cost this town a great deal of stone.
